title: Virtual-table and module reference ownership

scope.rationale: sqlite3VtabLock/Unlock and sqlite3VtabModuleUnref are the complete nested reference lifecycle consumed by P4_VTAB: VTable references protect disconnection, final unlock invokes xDisconnect, consumes a Module reference, runs optional module destructor, and releases both internal wrappers.
excluded_responsibilities: Public virtual-table implementation-owned memory beyond xDisconnect

external_source_responsibilities: Pinned sqlite3_module.xDisconnect and sqlite3_vtab.pModule ABI fields
Connection open/zombie state and caller mutex
dependencies.caller_closure: All active VTable/Module reference functions, internal wrapper representations and lifecycle-driving fields are assigned. Registration/deferred lists and P4 dispatch remain follow-on units.

inputs: live VTable with positive nRef, db in OPEN/ZOMBIE state, Module with positive nRefModule
optional public vtab and module xDestroy/pAux
outputs: nested lock increment, nonfinal decrement, or final disconnect/module-unref/wrapper release
contracts.ownership: VTable lock creates one claim. Final unlock invokes public xDisconnect when present, consumes one Module claim, then releases VTable. Final Module claim invokes xDestroy(pAux), requires no eponymous table, and releases Module.
contracts.state_and_results: Callbacks run before corresponding internal wrapper frees. xDisconnect result is ignored exactly as source.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds connection mutex. xDisconnect and xDestroy are synchronous callbacks; no direct I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: No allocation/OOM. Positive counts and valid connection state are asserted; final callbacks and frees occur once.

representation_differences: Pinned public sqlite3_module/sqlite3_vtab ABI prefixes are represented as exact extern Zig structures solely to invoke xDisconnect.
C ignores xDisconnect return; Zig explicitly discards it.

oracle.protocol: The shared worker allocates exact Module/VTable wrappers across absent/present public-vtab, absent/present module-destructor, and final/nonfinal Module-reference cases; it locks VTable 1->2, unlocks 2->1, then final-unlocks 1->0. C and Zig compare intermediate counts, conditional callback ordering/counts, and both internal wrappers returned to connection lookaside in a 366-observation trace.
internal_observations: xDisconnect runs exactly when a public vtab is present
module xDestroy runs exactly when configured
VTable retirement and final/nonfinal Module ownership
oracle.normalization: Addresses normalize to owning lookaside free-list membership. Counts and callback totals are exact.

assurance.oom: No allocation in assigned lifecycle; all test owners are returned exactly once.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Synchronous callbacks are reached; production mutex/deferred-disconnect concurrency remains integration work.
assurance.malformed_input: Assertions enforce positive refs, OPEN/ZOMBIE db and null pEpoTab at final module release.
assurance.continuation: Nonfinal VTable remains valid; final internal wrappers become inaccessible after callback completion.
assurance.performance: Constant-time reference operations and final callbacks preserve source shape.

integration.native_call_path: Symbolic worker reaches exact wrapper owners and public callbacks, including P4_VTAB attachment and release through the dependent VDBE destruction unit. The production virtual-table registry is pending.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Connect the production virtual-table registry and compiler lifecycle owners.

independent_review.notes: Requires P4/registry integration, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Connect production virtual-table registry owners to the completed P4/VDBE lifecycle.
